dashboards.name: Use cases · traffic and next steps
dashboards.description: Traffic, first next destination, and content interest for chat agents, coding agents, and workflow automation. Production langfuse.com only; Vercel previews and localhost excluded. New use_case events start after the tracking release. SQL tables use a fixed rolling 30 days.

dashboards.name: Use cases · CTA visibility and clicks
dashboards.description: Compare placements among visitors who actually saw each CTA. Exposure requires at least 50% visible for 1 second; only later same-visit clicks qualify. Distinct visitors, separate gateway/hooks paths. Production only. Starts after deployment; SQL tables use a fixed rolling 30 days.

dashboards.name: Use cases · completed conversions
dashboards.description: Use-case visits and actions leading to actual account creation or accepted Marketo inquiries. Signup window 14 days, sales window 1 day. Person identity joins website and Cloud. Existing signup event covers EU/US only; ad blocking and unavailable identity reduce coverage. Attribution is observational. New click and sales events require deployment.

insights.name: 0. Traffic by page
insights.description: Production pageviews and distinct visitors during the last 30 days. Preview hosts excluded. Historical pageview counts may include duplicates before this tracking release.

source.query: SELECT properties.$pathname AS page, count() AS pageviews, count(DISTINCT person_id) AS visitors FROM events WHERE event = '$pageview' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'langfuse.com' AND properties.$pathname IN ('/chat-agents','/coding-agents','/workflow-automation') GROUP BY page ORDER BY visitors DESC

insights.name: 0. Daily visitors by page
insights.description: Distinct visitors per day on the three production use-case pages; last 30 days. No preview traffic.

insights.name: 1. Where visitors go next
insights.description: First outbound action per use-case page visit; excludes image zoom and links within the same page. Counts visits and distinct people. Starts after deployment.

source.query: SELECT use_case, next_destination, count() AS visits, count(DISTINCT person_id) AS visitors FROM (SELECT person_id, properties.page_view_id AS visit, properties.use_case AS use_case, argMin(properties.destination_group, timestamp) AS next_destination FROM events WHERE event = 'use_case:action_clicked' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'langfuse.com' AND properties.use_case IN ('chat_agents', 'coding_agents', 'workflow_automation') AND properties.destination_group != 'image' AND properties.destination != properties.page_path AND properties.destination NOT LIKE concat(properties.page_path, '#%') GROUP BY person_id, visit, use_case) GROUP BY use_case, next_destination ORDER BY visits DESC

insights.name: 3. Benefits opened
insights.description: Explicit accordion opens only, excluding the initially open benefit. Broken down by page and gateway/hooks path.

source.query: SELECT properties.use_case AS use_case, properties.setup_path AS setup_path, properties.item AS benefit, count() AS opens, count(DISTINCT person_id) AS visitors FROM events WHERE event = 'use_case:benefit_opened' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'langfuse.com' AND properties.use_case IN ('chat_agents', 'coding_agents', 'workflow_automation') GROUP BY use_case, setup_path, benefit ORDER BY visitors DESC

insights.name: 3. Customer stories attracting interest
insights.description: Distinct people clicking each item on a use-case page, with the source placement and setup path. Each whole-card activation is counted once.

source.query: SELECT properties.use_case AS use_case, properties.setup_path AS setup_path, properties.section AS placement, properties.item AS item, properties.destination AS destination, count() AS clicks, count(DISTINCT person_id) AS visitors FROM events WHERE event = 'use_case:action_clicked' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'langfuse.com' AND properties.use_case IN ('chat_agents', 'coding_agents', 'workflow_automation') AND properties.destination_group = 'stories' GROUP BY use_case, setup_path, placement, item, destination ORDER BY visitors DESC LIMIT 100

insights.name: 3. Integrations attracting interest
insights.description: Distinct people clicking each item on a use-case page, with the source placement and setup path. Each whole-card activation is counted once.

source.query: SELECT properties.use_case AS use_case, properties.setup_path AS setup_path, properties.section AS placement, properties.item AS item, properties.destination AS destination, count() AS clicks, count(DISTINCT person_id) AS visitors FROM events WHERE event = 'use_case:action_clicked' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'langfuse.com' AND properties.use_case IN ('chat_agents', 'coding_agents', 'workflow_automation') AND properties.section = 'integrations' GROUP BY use_case, setup_path, placement, item, destination ORDER BY visitors DESC LIMIT 100

insights.name: 3. Docs and resources attracting interest
insights.description: Distinct people clicking each item on a use-case page, with the source placement and setup path. Each whole-card activation is counted once.

source.query: SELECT properties.use_case AS use_case, properties.setup_path AS setup_path, properties.section AS placement, properties.item AS item, properties.destination AS destination, count() AS clicks, count(DISTINCT person_id) AS visitors FROM events WHERE event = 'use_case:action_clicked' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'langfuse.com' AND properties.use_case IN ('chat_agents', 'coding_agents', 'workflow_automation') AND properties.destination_group IN ('docs', 'resources') GROUP BY use_case, setup_path, placement, item, destination ORDER BY visitors DESC LIMIT 100

insights.name: 3. Gateway versus hooks selections
insights.description: Explicit setup-path changes, including keyboard selection. The default selection is not an interaction.

source.query: SELECT properties.item AS setup_path, count() AS selections, count(DISTINCT person_id) AS visitors FROM events WHERE event = 'use_case:path_selected' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'langfuse.com' AND properties.use_case IN ('chat_agents', 'coding_agents', 'workflow_automation') GROUP BY setup_path ORDER BY visitors DESC

insights.name: 2. Click-through among visitors who saw each placement
insights.description: A view requires 50% of the link/card visible for 1 continuous second in the foreground. Numerator requires a later click on that same placement in that same page visit, then deduplicates people. Gateway/hooks are separate. Quick clicks without qualifying exposure are excluded from this rate.

source.query: SELECT use_case, setup_path, section, action, item, uniqIf(person_id, saw) AS exposed_visitors, uniqIf(person_id, saw AND clicked AND clicked_at >= exposed_at) AS exposed_clickers, round(100.0 * uniqIf(person_id, saw AND clicked AND clicked_at >= exposed_at) / nullIf(uniqIf(person_id, saw), 0), 1) AS exposed_ctr_percent FROM (SELECT person_id, properties.page_view_id AS visit, properties.placement_id AS placement, properties.use_case AS use_case, properties.setup_path AS setup_path, properties.section AS section, properties.action AS action, properties.item AS item, countIf(event = 'use_case:action_viewed') > 0 AS saw, countIf(event = 'use_case:action_clicked' AND properties.was_exposed = true) > 0 AS clicked, minIf(timestamp, event = 'use_case:action_viewed') AS exposed_at, maxIf(timestamp, event = 'use_case:action_clicked' AND properties.was_exposed = true) AS clicked_at FROM events WHERE event IN ('use_case:action_viewed', 'use_case:action_clicked') AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'langfuse.com' AND properties.use_case IN ('chat_agents', 'coding_agents', 'workflow_automation') AND properties.action IN ('start_free', 'talk_to_sales', 'quickstart', 'documentation') GROUP BY person_id, visit, placement, use_case, setup_path, section, action, item) GROUP BY use_case, setup_path, section, action, item HAVING exposed_visitors > 0 ORDER BY exposed_visitors DESC LIMIT 100

insights.name: 2. All CTA clicks, including quick clicks
insights.description: All signup and sales CTA clicks, including activations before the one-second visibility threshold. Use the exposure table for placement CTR.

source.query: SELECT properties.use_case AS use_case, properties.setup_path AS setup_path, properties.section AS placement, properties.action AS action, count() AS clicks, count(DISTINCT person_id) AS clickers, countIf(properties.was_exposed = false) AS quick_clicks FROM events WHERE event = 'use_case:action_clicked' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'langfuse.com' AND properties.use_case IN ('chat_agents', 'coding_agents', 'workflow_automation') AND properties.destination_group IN ('signup', 'sales') GROUP BY use_case, setup_path, placement, action ORDER BY clickers DESC

insights.name: 4. Page visit → completed signup
insights.description: A production use-case visit followed by cloud_signup_complete within 14 days, joined by PostHog person identity. Existing Cloud event covers EU/US only. Excludes preview hosts on the visit step. No signup is inferred from a button click.

insights.name: 4. Page visit → completed sales inquiry
insights.description: Production use-case visit followed by the Marketo success callback within 1 day, joined by person identity. This records accepted submissions, not form starts or button clicks. Starts after deployment.

insights.name: 4. Next destinations → completed signup
insights.description: Any outgoing action on a use-case page followed by a completed EU/US Cloud signup within 14 days. Broken down by the destination of the first qualifying action. Describes associations, not causal impact or exclusive attribution.

insights.name: 4. CTA placements → completed signup
insights.description: Start free clicks followed by actual EU/US signup within 14 days, broken down by stable placement ID. Person identity must be available across marketing and Cloud.

insights.name: 4. CTA placements → completed sales inquiry
insights.description: Talk to sales clicks followed by the Marketo success event within 1 day. Broken down by source placement ID.

insights.name: 4. Gateway versus hooks → completed signup
insights.description: Coding-agent CTA clicks followed by completed signup within 14 days, attributed to the path selected at the click. Only actual EU/US Cloud signup completions count.

insights.name: 4. Next destinations → completed sales inquiry
insights.description: A use-case outgoing action followed by an accepted Marketo sales inquiry within 1 day, broken down by the first qualifying destination. Includes paths through docs, stories, and integrations. Starts after deployment.
